[7] It is also stated that the Custody, Management and Disposal of Seized, Forfeited or
Confiscated Properties (General) Regulations, 2023 (the AMU Regulations), made under
section 14as read with section 10ofthe AMU Act, provides that the AMU and its officers
may do all things necessary for the securing and preservation of the value of properties
under their custody and control. Disposal of such properties shall be guided by Standard
Operating Procedures approved bythe Minister, with due regard to bonafide third parties.
Section 5(6) of POCCA provide that upon the making of a disposal order, the specified
property shall transfer to the Republic or other person specified inthe order.
[8] As per the Consent Application filed dated 03 June 2026, the Applicant, the 1 and 2
st nd

a)The parties consent to the making ofa Disposal Orderpursuant to section 5, and Section

this Agreement be transferred to the Republic.
b) The parties consent to the formal discharge of Superintendent Neville Thaver from his
appointment asReceiver with effectfrom the date ofthe consent disposal order and appoint
Miss Vickie Poussou, the Director of the Asset Management Unit of the Ministry of
Finance, Economic Planning, Trade, and Investment, as the receiver of these properties.
c)The parties jointly request that this Consent Application beplaced before the Honourable
Court for the making of the orders contemplated herein pursuant to section 19 of the
POCCA.

property andthe section 3order dated 28th April 2023 made byAdeline J,tendered toCourt
by learned counsel for the Applicant.
[11] I am also satisfied that there has been no objection by the Respondents that Miss Vickie
Poussou, be appointed as the Receiver of the schedule properties and to replace
Superintendent Neville Thaver as Receiver over ofthe property described.
[12J Learned Counsel for the Applicant informed Court that there is no application pending
under section 4(3) of the POCCA before any Court in respect of the said property. This
Court, having considered all the salient facts before it, is satisfied that no injustice will be
caused to any person in terms of Section 5 (10) of the said Act, if the Disposal Order be
grven.
[13] Itherefore proceed to issue the following orders:

that the whole of the following properties described in the Consent Application dated 03
June 2026, namely;
d) The vehicle make Kia Picanto, colour white, bearing registration number S23122,

Consent Application.
6. I further order that copies of this order be served on the Respondents, the Seychelles
Licensing Authority and any persons involved with the disposal of the specified
property in line with the Disposal Order of this Court inMe 28 of2023.
